title: Effects of LED photobiomodulation on pain, oedema, trismus, and the quality of life following the extraction of the mandibular third molar: a randomized blinded clinical trial
html: The extraction of the third molar is a frequent surgical procedure often associated with postoperative sequelae such as pain, oedema, and trismus, which can negatively impact patients’ quality of life. This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy of low-level light-emitting diode (LED) photobiomodulation (660 nm, continuous wave) in reducing these sequelae after mandibular third molar surgery. Forty-two patients were allocated to an active LED group (n = 21) or a placebo group (n = 21).
